scenes.head: Pocket
scenes.vo: This is Pocket. A money app you just talk to.

scenes.head: Money apps are hard
scenes.sub: Many apps, hidden fees, and AI you can't trust with your keys
scenes.vo: Sending money, buying a stock, or saving in dollars usually means many apps and fees you only see later. And nobody should hand an AI their keys.

scenes.head: Sign up in seconds
scenes.vo: Pick a name and tap create. Pocket makes you a real account on the NEAR test network. No seed phrase, and no fees.

scenes.head: Free test dollars
scenes.vo: You start with free test dollars.

scenes.head: Ask it anything
scenes.vo: Ask it anything, the way you would ask a friend.

scenes.head: Talk the way you talk
scenes.vo: Now a voice note, the way people really talk.
scenes.vo2: Pocket writes it down, works out what you meant, and checks with you first.
scenes.caption: A voice note, the way people really talk. Pocket writes it down, works out what you meant, and checks with you first.

scenes.head: One plan, checked in code
scenes.vo: Then it makes one plan. Your rules are checked in code, not by the AI. Nothing moves yet.

scenes.head: Press and hold to approve
scenes.vo: To approve, press and hold. Let go early and nothing happens. Pocket pays the network fee, and both steps settle in seconds.

scenes.head: A receipt from the chain
scenes.vo: The receipt is read straight from the chain. The price, the spread, and who filled the order.

scenes.head: You stay in control
scenes.vo: You set a daily limit, approve changes with your passkey, and see your AI credits.

scenes.head: Phone and desktop, live prices
scenes.vo: It works on phone and desktop, with live prices.

scenes.head: Why NEAR
bullets: Gasless sends paid by a relayer
Trades settle in the NEAR Intents verifier
The AI only proposes. You sign.
scenes.vo: NEAR makes this possible. Named accounts, gasless sends, and the NEAR Intents verifier that settles both sides of a trade at once. The AI only proposes. You sign.

scenes.head: Run it yourself
scenes.vo: Anyone can run the whole thing on testnet with one command, and every test passes.

scenes.head: Pocket
scenes.vo: Pocket. Talk to your money. Try it now.
